target_set.label: Target evaluation set
target_set.title: Evaluate the intended change
target_set.summary: A dataset role rather than a named benchmark: held-out examples for the behavior the update is intended to change. Editing probes the revised behavior, continual learning probes the new task, and unlearning probes the designated removal criterion.
steps: Specify the Task and target behavior.
Separate evaluation examples from optimization examples.
Include paraphrases or variants when testing generalization.
Record the split, scoring rule, and any overlap with training data.

retain_set.label: Retained evaluation set
retain_set.title: Evaluate behavior that should remain
retain_set.summary: A dataset role rather than a named benchmark: held-out examples covering knowledge or capabilities that should survive the update. Keep evaluation examples separate from any replay or preservation examples used for optimization.
steps: Define the capabilities to preserve.
Create a held-out evaluation split covering those capabilities.
Evaluate the reference and adapted models on the same examples.
Report results by capability as well as in aggregate.
